comments.author: FiveF
comments.body_html:
I tested and see this problem. The reason for this unplanned behavior is changing IsAlwaysSpawn to true.

I generally don’t use it anymore in my new version (not published yet), because it didn’t do much + i added new feature - spawnMultipler. I will update it in the next few days. I have already done everything but I have to export it to this mod.

To fix it, edit the alwaysSpawnContainers.ts file to this:

//import { DependencyContainer } from “tsyringe”; import { DependencyContainer } from “@spt/models/external/tsyringe”; import { ILogger } from “@spt/models/spt/utils/ILogger”; import { IPostDBLoadMod } from “@spt/models/external/IPostDBLoadMod”; import { DatabaseServer } from “@spt/servers/DatabaseServer”; import { ConfigServer } from “@spt/servers/ConfigServer”; import { IDatabaseTables } from “@spt/models/spt/server/IDatabaseTables”; //jsonc thing - 1/2 import path from “node:path”; import { jsonc } from “jsonc”; import { FileSystemSync } from “@spt/utils/FileSystemSync”; class alwaysSpawnContainers implements IPostDBLoadMod { public postDBLoad(container: DependencyContainer): void { const databaseServer = container.resolve<DatabaseServer>(“DatabaseServer”); const configServer = container.resolve<ConfigServer>(“ConfigServer”); const logger = container.resolve<ILogger>(“WinstonLogger”); //jsonc thing - 2/2 const fileSystem = container.resolve<FileSystemSync>(“FileSystemSync”); const modConfigJsonC = jsonc.parse(fileSystem.read(path.resolve(__dirname, “../config/config.jsonc”))); const tables: IDatabaseTables = databaseServer.getTables(); const locationsData = tables.locations; let changeCount_containers = 0; let changeCount_containersAS = 0; let changeCount_looseLootItems = 0; let changeCount_looseLootItemsAS = 0; if (modConfigJsonC.enableMod) { for (const key in locationsData) { const location = locationsData[key]; //containers if (modConfigJsonC.alwaysSpawn_containers) { if (location?.staticContainers?.staticContainers) { location.staticContainers.staticContainers.forEach(container => { if (container.probability !== undefined && container.probability !== 1) { let v1a = container.template.Id; let v1b = container.probability; container.probability = 1; changeCount_containers++ /* if (modConfigJsonC.logging) { logger.info(${v1a} set from ${v1b} to ${container.probability}); } */ } }); } } //items if (modConfigJsonC.alwaysSpawn_looseLootItems) { if (location?.looseLoot?.spawnpoints) { location.looseLoot.spawnpoints.forEach(spawnPoint => { if (spawnPoint.probability !== undefined && spawnPoint.probability !== 1) { spawnPoint.probability = 1; changeCount_looseLootItems++ } }); } } } //logging if (modConfigJsonC.logging) { logger.info(Always Spawn Containers logging:); logger.info(-Changes count for Static Containers: \\t\\t\\t ${changeCount\_containers}); logger.info(-Changes count for Static Containers IsAlwaysSpawn: \\t ${changeCount\_containersAS}); logger.info(-Changes count for Loose Loot Items: \\t\\t\\t ${changeCount\_looseLootItems}); logger.info(-Changes count for Loose Loot Items IsAlwaysSpawn: \\t ${changeCount\_looseLootItemsAS}); } } } } export const mod = new alwaysSpawnContainers();
